I will still do cotton on all 3.0 mu, same as last year, because on a small piece of land like mine I do not like changing too much. Around here in Quzhou, if cotton price is acceptable and I have well water, I can still manage it steadily. I have middle school education, so I do not just copy blindly, but I still look at what works on nearby fields first. If the neighbors who planted improved cotton seed did well and the stand was even, I will use improved seed again. On fertilizer, I would rather spend a bit more than let the cotton go hungry, especially once squares and bolls start setting. But my land is only 3 mu, so every bag costs money, and I still have to leave room in the household budget for pesticide, irrigation electricity, and some hired help if needed. I will put most of the phosphorus and potassium in as base fertilizer, then split nitrogen, with more going in before the fast growth stage. With well irrigation, I will plan for about 3 waterings if the rain does not come at the right time. For pests, I will not spray by calendar only, but in a normal year I usually end up spraying about 4 times for aphids, bollworm, mites, or other troubles. For tillage, I will plough first, because cotton roots do better when the soil is opened up properly. If the weather is normal, I will count on about 330 kg per mu of seed cotton. That is not the highest number, but for my age, my land size, and the money I can put in, it is a realistic target.
